local function finite(x) return type(x) == "number" and x == x and math.abs(x) < math.huge end
local function isInteger(x) return finite(x) and x % 1 == 0 end
local function fail(message) error("SpringChart: " .. message, 3) end
local function fmt(x) return if finite(x) then string.format("%.2f", x) else "—" end
local function pct(x) return if finite(x) then string.format("%+.2f%%", x * 100) else "—" end

local function resolveEnv(options)
	local injected = options.env
	if injected ~= nil and type(injected) ~= "table" then fail("options.env must be a table") end
	local defaults = { Instance = Instance, UDim2 = UDim2, UDim = UDim, Color3 = Color3, Enum = Enum, Vector2 = Vector2 }
	local env = {}
	for _, name in ROBLOX_GLOBALS do
		local value = injected and injected[name]
		if value == nil then value = defaults[name] end
		if value == nil then fail("Roblox global " .. name .. " is unavailable; inject it through options.env") end
		env[name] = value
	end
	return env
end

local function barsProblem(bars)
	if type(bars) ~= "table" then return "bars table required" end
	local n = bars.t and #bars.t
	if not isInteger(n) or n < 1 then return "bars.t must be a non-empty array" end
	for _, key in { "o", "h", "l", "c" } do
		if type(bars[key]) ~= "table" or #bars[key] ~= n then return "bars." .. key .. " must hold " .. n .. " values" end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Exact per-trade net P&L from ledger equity (full-equity sizing, flat between trades):
-- net = equity at the close of the exit-fill bar / equity at the close of the bar before the entry fill - 1.
-- Only rows 1..index are read. Returns trades (exitRow -> net), wins, losses, the open trade's marked P&L and the last net.
local function tradeStats(rows, index)
	local nets, wins, losses, last = {}, 0, 0, nil
	local entryEquity = nil
	for i = 1, index do
		local r = rows[i]
		for _, f in r.ex or {} do
			if f.a == "BUY" or f.a == "SELL" then
				entryEquity = if i > 1 then rows[i - 1].eq else 1
			elseif f.a == "CLOSE" and entryEquity and finite(r.eq) and finite(entryEquity) and entryEquity > 0 then
				local net = r.eq / entryEquity - 1
				nets[i] = net
				last = net
				if net > 0 then wins += 1 elseif net < 0 then losses += 1 end
				entryEquity = nil
			end
		end
	end
	local cur = rows[index]
	local open = if cur.po ~= 0 and entryEquity and finite(cur.eq) and entryEquity > 0 then cur.eq / entryEquity - 1 else nil
	return nets, wins, losses, open, last
end

	self._speedKnob = make("Frame", track, { Name = "SpeedKnob", AnchorPoint = env.Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UD2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UD2.fromOffset(12, 12), BackgroundColor3 = C.text, BorderSizePixel = 0 })
	make("UICorner", self._speedKnob, { CornerRadius = env.UDim.new(1, 0) })
	self._speedValue = label(speed, "SpeedValue", { Position = UD2.fromOffset(52 + TRACK_WIDTH, 0), Size = UD2.fromOffset(78, 20), TextSize = 10,
		Font = E.Font.GothamMedium })
	local smooth = make("TextButton", speed, { Name = "Smooth", Position = UD2.fromOffset(134 + TRACK_WIDTH, 2), Size = UD2.fromOffset(78, 16),
		BackgroundColor3 = C.grid, TextColor3 = C.text, TextSize = 10, Font = E.Font.GothamMedium, BorderSizePixel = 0, AutoButtonColor = true })
	self._smoothButton = smooth
	local dragging = false
	local function fromX(px)
		local pos, size = track.AbsolutePosition, track.AbsoluteSize
		if not pos or not size or not finite(size.X) or size.X <= 0 or not finite(px) then return end
		self:_setSpeedFraction(math.clamp((px - pos.X) / size.X, 0, 1), true)
	end
	self._handlers.Speed = function(fraction) self:_setSpeedFraction(fraction, true) end
	self._handlers.Smooth = function() self:setSmooth(not self._smooth, true) end
	table.insert(self._connections, track.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function(px) if not self._destroyed then dragging = true; fromX(px) end end))
	table.insert(self._connections, track.MouseMoved:Connect(function(px) if dragging and not self._destroyed then fromX(px) end end))
	table.insert(self._connections, track.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() dragging = false end))
	table.insert(self._connections, track.MouseLeave:Connect(function() dragging = false end))
	table.insert(self._connections, smooth.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() if not self._destroyed then self._handlers.Smooth() end end))
	local buttons = {}
	for k, w in WINDOWS do
		local b = make("TextButton", frame, { Name = "Window_" .. w.id, Text = w.id, AnchorPoint = env.Vector2.new(1, 0),
			Position = UD2.new(1, -46 - (#WINDOWS - k) * 34, 0, 4), Size = UD2.fromOffset(30, 18), BackgroundColor3 = C.grid,
			TextColor3 = C.text, TextSize = 10, Font = E.Font.GothamMedium, BorderSizePixel = 0, AutoButtonColor = true })
		local handler = function() self:setWindow(w.id) end
		self._handlers[b.Name] = handler
		table.insert(self._connections, b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() if not self._destroyed then handler() end end))
		buttons[w.id] = b
	end
	local hide = make("TextButton", frame, { Name = "Hide", Text = "hide", AnchorPoint = env.Vector2.new(1, 0),
		Position = UD2.new(1, -8, 0, 4), Size = UD2.fromOffset(34, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = C.muted, TextSize = 10,
		Font = E.Font.Gotham, BorderSizePixel = 0 })
	self._windowButtons = buttons
	self._hideButton = hide
	self._handlers.Hide = function() self:setHidden(not self._hidden) end
	table.insert(self._connections, hide.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() if not self._destroyed then self._handlers.Hide() end end))

	local plot = make("Frame", frame, { Name = "Plot", Position = UD2.fromOffset(PAD_LEFT, HEADER + PAD_TOP),
		Size = UD2.new(1, -(PAD_LEFT + PAD_RIGHT), 1, -(HEADER + PAD_TOP + PAD_BOTTOM)), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0 })
	self._plot = plot
	local price = make("Frame", plot, { Name = "PricePane", Size = UD2.new(1, 0, PRICE_SHARE, -PANE_GAP / 2), BackgroundColor3 = C.plot,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = true })
	local pnl = make("Frame", plot, { Name = "PnlPane", Position = UD2.new(0, 0, PRICE_SHARE, PANE_GAP / 2),
		Size = UD2.new(1, 0, 1 - PRICE_SHARE, -PANE_GAP / 2), BackgroundColor3 = C.plot, BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ClipsDescendants = true })
	self._price, self._pnl = price, pnl
	self._pnlTitle = label(pnl, "PnlTitle", { Position = UD2.fromOffset(6, 2), Size = UD2.fromOffset(260, 14), TextSize = 10,
		TextColor3 = C.muted, ZIndex = 6, Text = "CUMULATIVE NET P&L (fees, slippage, borrow included)" })

	self._axis = {}
	for k = 1, 3 do
		self._axis[k] = label(frame, "Axis" .. k, { AnchorPoint = env.Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UD2.new(1, -PAD_RIGHT + 6, 0, 0),
			Size = UD2.fromOffset(PAD_RIGHT - 8, 14), TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = C.accent, Font = E.Font.RobotoMono })
	end
	self._pnlAxis = label(frame, "PnlAxis", { AnchorPoint = env.Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UD2.new(1, -PAD_RIGHT + 6, 1, -PAD_BOTTOM - 20),
		Size = UD2.fromOffset(PAD_RIGHT - 8, 16), TextSize = 12, Font = E.Font.GothamBold, TextColor3 = C.text })
	self._timeLeft = label(frame, "TimeLeft", { AnchorPoint = env.Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UD2.new(0, PAD_LEFT, 1, -3),
		Size = UD2.new(0.18, 0, 0, 14), TextSize = 10, TextColor3 = C.muted, Font = E.Font.RobotoMono })
	self._timeRight = label(frame, "TimeRight", { AnchorPoint = env.Vector2.new(1, 1), Position = UD2.new(1, -PAD_RIGHT, 1, -3),
		Size = UD2.new(0.18, 0, 0, 14), TextSize = 10, TextColor3 = C.muted, TextXAlignment = E.TextXAlignment.Right, Font = E.Font.RobotoMono })
	self._legend = label(frame, "Legend", { AnchorPoint = env.Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UD2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -3),
		Size = UD2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 14), TextSize = 10, TextColor3 = C.muted, TextXAlignment = E.TextXAlignment.Center,
		TextTruncate = E.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		Text = "▲ BUY  ▼ SELL  × CLOSE on the decision bar · ● fill · % = closed trade net P&L · tint = position · no bar after the cursor" })

	-- Price pane pools: one column (tint + wick + body) per drawable bar, markers + captions, fill dots, trade P&L labels.
	self._columns = table.create(MAX_BARS)
	for k = 1, MAX_BARS do
		local tint = make("Frame", price, { Name = "Tint" .. k, BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, ZIndex = 1,
			Size = UD2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), Position = UD2.new(0, 0, 0, 0) })
		local wick = make("Frame", price, { Name = "Wick" .. k, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = env.Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Visible = false, ZIndex = 2,
			Size = UD2.new(0, 1, 0, 0) })
		local body = make("Frame", price, { Name = "Body" .. k, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = env.Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Visible = false, ZIndex = 3 })
		local bar = make("Frame", pnl, { Name = "PnlBar" .. k, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = env.Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Visible = false, ZIndex = 2,
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.25 })
		self._columns[k] = { tint = tint, wick = wick, body = body, pnl = bar }
	end
	self._marks, self._captions, self._dots, self._tradeLabels = table.create(MAX_MARKS), table.create(MAX_MARKS), table.create(MAX_MARKS), table.create(MAX_MARKS)
	for k = 1, MAX_MARKS do
		self._marks[k] = label(price, "Mark" .. k, { AnchorPoint = env.Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UD2.fromOffset(30, 30), TextSize = 28,
			Font = E.Font.GothamBlack, TextXAlignment = E.TextXAlignment.Center, TextStrokeColor3 = C.outline, TextStrokeTransparency = 0.1,
			Visible = false, ZIndex = 8 })
		self._captions[k] = label(price, "Caption" .. k, { AnchorPoint = env.Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UD2.fromOffset(48, 14), TextSize = 11,
			Font = E.Font.GothamBlack, TextXAlignment = E.TextXAlignment.Center, TextStrokeColor3 = C.outline, TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2,
			Visible = false, ZIndex = 8 })
		local dot = make("Frame", price, { Name = "Fill" .. k, AnchorPoint = env.Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UD2.fromOffset(11, 11),
			BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, ZIndex = 9 })
		make("UICorner", dot, { CornerRadius = env.UDim.new(1, 0) })
		make("UIStroke", dot, { Color = C.outline, Thickness = 1.5 })
		self._dots[k] = dot
		self._tradeLabels[k] = label(price, "TradePnl" .. k, { AnchorPoint = env.Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Size = UD2.fromOffset(64, 16), TextSize = 13,
			Font = E.Font.GothamBlack, TextXAlignment = E.TextXAlignment.Center, TextStrokeColor3 = C.outline, TextStrokeTransparency = 0.1,
			Visible = false, ZIndex = 10 })
	end
	self._levels = {}
	for _, name in { "Stop", "Target", "Last" } do
		self._levels[name] = make("Frame", price, { Name = name .. "Level", BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UD2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), Visible = false, ZIndex = 4,
			BackgroundColor3 = if name == "Stop" then C.stop elseif name == "Target" then C.target else C.cursor, BackgroundTransparency = 0.25 })
	end
	self._cursor = make("Frame", price, { Name = "Cursor", BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = env.Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Size = UD2.new(0, 1, 1, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = C.cursor, BackgroundTransparency = 0.55, Visible = false, ZIndex = 4 })
	self._zero = make("Frame", pnl, { Name = "ZeroLine", BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UD2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = C.muted,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, Visible = false, ZIndex = 3 })
	gui.Parent = parent
	self:_highlightWindow()
	self:setRate(options.rate or 6)
	self:setSmooth(self._smooth, false)
	return self
end

local function rateFromFraction(f) return MIN_RATE * (MAX_RATE / MIN_RATE) ^ math.clamp(f, 0, 1) end
local function fractionFromRate(r) return math.clamp(math.log(r / MIN_RATE) / math.log(MAX_RATE / MIN_RATE), 0, 1) end
SpringChart.rateFromFraction, SpringChart.fractionFromRate = rateFromFraction, fractionFromRate

function Chart:_showRate(rate)
	local f = fractionFromRate(rate)
	self._speedKnob.Position = self.env.UDim2.new(f, 0, 0.5, 0)
	self._speedFill.Size = self.env.UDim2.new(f, 0, 0, 4)
	self._speedValue.Text = if rate >= 1 then string.format("%.1f candles/s", rate) else string.format("1 candle / %.1fs", 1 / rate)
	self.screenGui:SetAttribute("Rate", rate)
end

-- Sets the displayed rate without calling back (the host already knows it).
function Chart:setRate(rate)
	if self._destroyed then return end
	rate = math.clamp(tonumber(rate) or 6, MIN_RATE, MAX_RATE)
	self._rate = rate
	self:_showRate(rate)
end

function Chart:_setSpeedFraction(fraction, notify)
	if self._destroyed or not finite(fraction) then return end
	local rate = rateFromFraction(fraction)
	self._rate = rate
	self:_showRate(rate)
	if notify and type(self._onRate) == "function" then pcall(self._onRate, rate) end
end

function Chart:setSmooth(on, notify)
	if self._destroyed then return end
	self._smooth = on == true
	self._smoothButton.Text = if self._smooth then "smooth: on" else "smooth: off"
	self._smoothButton.BackgroundColor3 = if self._smooth then self._colors.accent else self._colors.grid
	self._smoothButton.TextColor3 = if self._smooth then self._colors.bg else self._colors.accent
	self.screenGui:SetAttribute("Smooth", self._smooth)
	if notify and type(self._onSmooth) == "function" then pcall(self._onSmooth, self._smooth) end
end

function Chart:_highlightWindow()
	for _, w in WINDOWS do
		local b = self._windowButtons[w.id]
		local selected = w.bars == self._window
		b.BackgroundColor3 = if selected then self._colors.accent else self._colors.grid
		b.TextColor3 = if selected then self._colors.bg else self._colors.accent
	end
end

function Chart:setWindow(id)
	if self._destroyed then return false end
	for _, w in WINDOWS do
		if w.id == id then
			self._window = w.bars
			self:_highlightWindow()
			self.screenGui:SetAttribute("Window", id)
			if self._last then self:update(table.unpack(self._last)) end
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function Chart:setHidden(hidden)
	if self._destroyed then return end
	self._hidden = hidden == true
	self._fullSize = self._fullSize or self._frame.Size
	self._plot.Visible = not self._hidden
	self._frame.Size = if self._hidden then self.env.UDim2.new(self._fullSize.X.Scale, self._fullSize.X.Offset, 0, 26) else self._fullSize
	self._hideButton.Text = if self._hidden then "show" else "hide"
	for _, l in self._axis do l.Visible = not self._hidden end
	self._pnlAxis.Visible = not self._hidden
	self._timeLeft.Visible, self._timeRight.Visible, self._legend.Visible = not self._hidden, not self._hidden, not self._hidden
end

function Chart:testActivate(id, ...)
	assert(not self._destroyed, "SpringChart: destroyed")
	local handler = self._handlers[id]
	assert(handler, "SpringChart: unknown control " .. tostring(id))
	handler(...)
	return true
end

-- update(index, bars, rows, info): index = replay cursor (1-based); bars = {t,o,h,l,c} arrays; rows = the selected run's
-- compact rows (fa/fs final action and source, ex fills {a,p,r,s}, po position, sp/tg stop/target, eq equity);
-- info = {runLabel, label (cursor time text), labels (optional per-row time labels)}.
function Chart:update(index, bars, rows, info)
	if self._destroyed then fail("update after destroy") end
	local problem = barsProblem(bars)
	if problem then fail(problem) end
	local n = #bars.t
	if not isInteger(index) or index < 1 or index > n then fail("index out of range") end
	if type(rows) ~= "table" or #rows ~= n then fail("rows must hold one compact row per bar") end
	info = info or {}
	self._fullSize = self._fullSize or self._frame.Size
	self._last = { index, bars, rows, info }
	local C, UD2 = self._colors, self.env.UDim2
	local W = self._window
	local first = math.max(1, index - W + 1)
	local count = index - first + 1
	local cur = rows[index]
	local nets, wins, losses, openPnl, lastNet = tradeStats(rows, index)

	-- Price range over the drawn bars (never beyond the cursor), plus the open trade's levels.
	local lo, hi = math.huge, -math.huge
	for i = first, index do lo = math.min(lo, bars.l[i]); hi = math.max(hi, bars.h[i]) end
	if cur.po ~= 0 then
		if finite(cur.sp) then lo = math.min(lo, cur.sp); hi = math.max(hi, cur.sp) end
		if finite(cur.tg) then lo = math.min(lo, cur.tg); hi = math.max(hi, cur.tg) end
	end
	local span = math.max(hi - lo, 1e-9)
	lo, hi = lo - span * 0.12, hi + span * 0.12 -- headroom for the large markers
	span = hi - lo
	local function y(p) return math.clamp((hi - p) / span, 0, 1) end
	local function x(k) return (k - 0.5) / W end
	local width = 1 / W

	-- Cumulative P&L range over the drawn bars (equity - 1); zero always visible.
	local pLo, pHi = 0, 0
	for i = first, index do
		local v = if finite(rows[i].eq) then rows[i].eq - 1 else 0
		pLo, pHi = math.min(pLo, v), math.max(pHi, v)
	end
	local pSpan = math.max(pHi - pLo, 0.0005)
	pLo, pHi = pLo - pSpan * 0.15, pHi + pSpan * 0.15
	pSpan = pHi - pLo
	local function py(v) return math.clamp((pHi - v) / pSpan, 0, 1) end
	local zeroY = py(0)

	for k = 1, MAX_BARS do
		local col = self._columns[k]
		if k <= count then
			local i = first + k - 1
			local o, h, l, c = bars.o[i], bars.h[i], bars.l[i], bars.c[i]
			local color = if c >= o then C.up else C.down
			col.wick.Visible, col.body.Visible = true, true
			col.wick.BackgroundColor3 = color
			col.wick.Position = UD2.new(x(k), 0, y(h), 0)
			col.wick.Size = UD2.new(0, 1, math.max(y(l) - y(h), 0), 1)
			col.body.BackgroundColor3 = color
			col.body.Position = UD2.new(x(k), 0, y(math.max(o, c)), 0)
			col.body.Size = UD2.new(width * 0.62, 0, math.max(y(math.min(o, c)) - y(math.max(o, c)), 0), 1)
			local pos = rows[i].po
			col.tint.Visible = pos ~= 0
			if pos ~= 0 then
				col.tint.BackgroundColor3 = if pos == 1 then C.long else C.short
				col.tint.BackgroundTransparency = 0.78
				col.tint.Position = UD2.new((k - 1) / W, 0, 0, 0)
				col.tint.Size = UD2.new(width, 1, 1, 0)
			end
			local v = if finite(rows[i].eq) then rows[i].eq - 1 else 0
			local vy = py(v)
			col.pnl.Visible = true
			col.pnl.BackgroundColor3 = if v >= 0 then C.up else C.down
			col.pnl.Position = UD2.new(x(k), 0, math.min(vy, zeroY), 0)
			col.pnl.Size = UD2.new(width * 0.9, 1, math.abs(vy - zeroY), 1)
			col.pnl:SetAttribute("Pnl", v)
		else
			col.wick.Visible, col.body.Visible, col.tint.Visible, col.pnl.Visible = false, false, false, false
		end
	end

	-- Decision markers (large, outlined, captioned) on the decision bar; fills at the fill price; trade P&L at exits.
	local m, d, tl = 0, 0, 0
	for k = 1, count do
		local i = first + k - 1
		local r = rows[i]
		local action = r.fa
		if (action == "BUY" or action == "SELL" or action == "CLOSE") and m < MAX_MARKS then
			m += 1
			local mark, caption = self._marks[m], self._captions[m]
			mark.Visible, caption.Visible = true, true
			if action == "BUY" then
				mark.Text, mark.TextColor3 = "▲", C.buy
				mark.Position = UD2.new(x(k), 0, y(bars.l[i]), 16)
				caption.Text, caption.TextColor3 = "BUY", C.buy
				caption.Position = UD2.new(x(k), 0, y(bars.l[i]), 38)
			elseif action == "SELL" then
				mark.Text, mark.TextColor3 = "▼", C.sell
				mark.Position = UD2.new(x(k), 0, y(bars.h[i]), -16)
				caption.Text, caption.TextColor3 = "SELL", C.sell
				caption.Position = UD2.new(x(k), 0, y(bars.h[i]), -38)
			else
				mark.Text, mark.TextColor3 = "×", C.close
				mark.Position = UD2.new(x(k), 0, y(bars.h[i]), -16)
				caption.Text, caption.TextColor3 = "CLOSE", C.close
				caption.Position = UD2.new(x(k), 0, y(bars.h[i]), -38)
			end
			mark:SetAttribute("Row", i); mark:SetAttribute("Action", action); mark:SetAttribute("Source", r.fs)
		end
		for _, f in r.ex or {} do
			if d < MAX_MARKS and finite(f.p) then
				d += 1
				local dot = self._dots[d]
				dot.Visible = true
				dot.BackgroundColor3 = if f.a == "BUY" then C.buy elseif f.a == "SELL" then C.sell
					elseif f.r == "target" then C.target elseif f.r == "stop" or f.r == "stop_gap" then C.stop else C.cursor
				dot.Position = UD2.new(x(k), 0, y(f.p), 0)
				dot:SetAttribute("Row", i); dot:SetAttribute("Action", f.a); dot:SetAttribute("Reason", f.r); dot:SetAttribute("Price", f.p)
				if f.a == "CLOSE" and nets[i] ~= nil and tl < MAX_MARKS then
					tl += 1
					local t = self._tradeLabels[tl]
					t.Visible = true
					t.Text = pct(nets[i])
					t.TextColor3 = if nets[i] >= 0 then C.buy else C.sell
					t.Position = UD2.new(x(k), 0, y(f.p), -9)
					t:SetAttribute("Row", i); t:SetAttribute("Net", nets[i])
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for k = m + 1, MAX_MARKS do self._marks[k].Visible = false; self._captions[k].Visible = false end
	for k = d + 1, MAX_MARKS do self._dots[k].Visible = false end
	for k = tl + 1, MAX_MARKS do self._tradeLabels[k].Visible = false end

	local open = cur.po ~= 0
	self._levels.Stop.Visible = open and finite(cur.sp)
	if self._levels.Stop.Visible then self._levels.Stop.Position = UD2.new(0, 0, y(cur.sp), 0) end
	self._levels.Target.Visible = open and finite(cur.tg)
	if self._levels.Target.Visible then self._levels.Target.Position = UD2.new(0, 0, y(cur.tg), 0) end
	self._levels.Last.Visible = true
	self._levels.Last.Position = UD2.new(0, 0, y(bars.c[index]), 0)
	self._cursor.Visible = true
	self._cursor.Position = UD2.new(x(count), 0, 0, 0)
	self._zero.Visible = true
	self._zero.Position = UD2.new(0, 0, zeroY, 0)

	-- Axis labels in frame coordinates: the price pane is the top PRICE_SHARE of the plot area.
	local top = HEADER + PAD_TOP
	local function axisAt(fraction)
		local s = fraction * PRICE_SHARE
		return UD2.new(1, -PAD_RIGHT + 6, s, top - s * (top + PAD_BOTTOM))
	end
	local lastFraction = y(bars.c[index])
	self._axis[1].Text, self._axis[1].Position = fmt(hi), axisAt(0)
	self._axis[3].Text, self._axis[3].Position = fmt(lo), axisAt(1)
	self._axis[2].Text, self._axis[2].Position = fmt(bars.c[index]), axisAt(lastFraction)
	self._axis[2].TextColor3 = C.cursor
	self._axis[1].Visible = not self._hidden and lastFraction > 0.08
	self._axis[3].Visible = not self._hidden and lastFraction < 0.92
	self._axis[2]:SetAttribute("PriceFraction", lastFraction)
	local total = if finite(cur.eq) then cur.eq - 1 else nil
	local pnlFraction = PRICE_SHARE + (1 - PRICE_SHARE) * py(total or 0)
	self._pnlAxis.Text = pct(total)
	self._pnlAxis.TextColor3 = if (total or 0) >= 0 then C.buy else C.sell
	self._pnlAxis.Position = UD2.new(1, -PAD_RIGHT + 6, pnlFraction, top - pnlFraction * (top + PAD_BOTTOM))

	local labels = info.labels
	self._timeLeft.Text = if labels and labels[first] then tostring(labels[first]) else ""
	self._timeRight.Text = if labels and labels[index] then tostring(labels[index]) else (info.label or "")
	local position = if cur.po == 1 then "LONG" elseif cur.po == -1 then "SHORT" else "FLAT"
	self._title.Text = string.format("SPY 5-MIN · %s", string.upper(tostring(info.runLabel or "")))
	local function colored(text, value)
		local hex = if (value or 0) >= 0 then "#4AE85A" else "#FF433D"
		return string.format('<font color="%s"><b>%s</b></font>', hex, text)
	end
	self._readout.Text = string.format("%s · close %s · %s%s · P&L %s · trades W%d / L%d%s", tostring(info.label or ""), fmt(bars.c[index]), position,
		if openPnl then " " .. colored(pct(openPnl), openPnl) else "", colored(pct(total), total), wins, losses,
		if lastNet then " · last " .. colored(pct(lastNet), lastNet) else "")
	local g = self.screenGui

local K256 = {

	0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
	0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
	0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
	0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
	0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2,
}
local WORDS16 = ">" .. string.rep("I4", 16)
local function sha256(message)
	assert(type(message) == "string", "sha256 needs a string")
	local band, bxor, bnot, rrotate, rshift = bit32.band, bit32.bxor, bit32.bnot, bit32.rrotate, bit32.rshift
	local M = 4294967296
	local length = #message
	local bits = length * 8
	message = message .. "\128" .. string.rep("\0", (55 - length) % 64)
		.. string.pack(">I4I4", math.floor(bits / M), bits % M)
	local h0, h1, h2, h3 = 0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a
	local h4, h5, h6, h7 = 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19
	local w = table.create(64, 0)
	for offset = 1, #message, 64 do
		w[1], w[2], w[3], w[4], w[5], w[6], w[7], w[8], w[9], w[10], w[11], w[12], w[13], w[14], w[15], w[16] =
			string.unpack(WORDS16, message, offset)
		for i = 17, 64 do
			local x, y = w[i - 15], w[i - 2]
			local s0 = bxor(rrotate(x, 7), rrotate(x, 18), rshift(x, 3))
			local s1 = bxor(rrotate(y, 17), rrotate(y, 19), rshift(y, 10))
			w[i] = (w[i - 16] + s0 + w[i - 7] + s1) % M
		end
		local a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h = h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7
		for i = 1, 64 do
			local S1 = bxor(rrotate(e, 6), rrotate(e, 11), rrotate(e, 25))
			local ch = bxor(band(e, f), band(bnot(e), g))
			local t1 = (h + S1 + ch + K256[i] + w[i]) % M
			local S0 = bxor(rrotate(a, 2), rrotate(a, 13), rrotate(a, 22))
			local maj = bxor(band(a, b), band(a, c), band(b, c))
			h, g, f, e, d, c, b, a = g, f, e, (d + t1) % M, c, b, a, (t1 + S0 + maj) % M
		end
		h0, h1, h2, h3 = (h0 + a) % M, (h1 + b) % M, (h2 + c) % M, (h3 + d) % M
		h4, h5, h6, h7 = (h4 + e) % M, (h5 + f) % M, (h6 + g) % M, (h7 + h) % M
	end
	return string.format("%08x%08x%08x%08x%08x%08x%08x%08x", h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7)
end

-- Exact JSON encoder. Numbers: %.17g (exact for every finite double; JSON.parse in the server reads back the same
-- double). NaN/Infinity, nil holes, mixed or cyclic tables, functions and userdata raise. Keys are sorted; output is
-- ASCII only (non-ASCII becomes \uXXXX, astral code points as surrogate pairs).
local ESCAPES = { [8] = "\\b", [9] = "\\t", [10] = "\\n", [12] = "\\f", [13] = "\\r", [34] = '\\"', [92] = "\\\\" }

local function pathText(path) return "$" .. table.concat(path) end
local function encodeString(s, path)
	if not string.find(s, '[%c"\\\128-\255]') then return '"' .. s .. '"' end
	if utf8.len(s) == nil then error("SpringLive.encode: invalid UTF-8 at " .. pathText(path), 0) end
	local out = { '"' }
	for _, cp in utf8.codes(s) do
		local short = ESCAPES[cp]
		if short then
			table.insert(out, short)
		elseif cp < 0x20 or cp >= 0x7F then
			if cp >= 0x10000 then
				local v = cp - 0x10000
				table.insert(out, string.format("\\u%04x\\u%04x", 0xD800 + bit32.rshift(v, 10), 0xDC00 + bit32.band(v, 0x3FF)))
			else
				table.insert(out, string.format("\\u%04x", cp))
			end
		else
			table.insert(out, string.char(cp))
		end
	end
	table.insert(out, '"')
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function encodeValue(value, path, visiting, out)
	local kind = type(value)
	if kind == "number" then
		if value ~= value or value == math.huge or value == -math.huge then
			error("SpringLive.encode: non-finite number at " .. pathText(path), 0)
		end
		table.insert(out, string.format("%.17g", value))
	elseif kind == "string" then
		table.insert(out, encodeString(value, path))
	elseif kind == "boolean" then
		table.insert(out, if value then "true" else "false")
	elseif kind == "table" then
		if visiting[value] then error("SpringLive.encode: cycle at " .. pathText(path), 0) end
		if #path > 64 then error("SpringLive.encode: nesting too deep at " .. pathText(path), 0) end
		local keys, count, maxIndex = {}, 0, 0
		for k in value do
			if type(k) == "string" then
				table.insert(keys, k)
			elseif type(k) == "number" and k == math.floor(k) and k >= 1 then
				count += 1
				if k > maxIndex then maxIndex = k end
			else
				error("SpringLive.encode: unsupported key " .. tostring(k) .. " at " .. pathText(path), 0)
			end
		end
		if #keys > 0 and count > 0 then error("SpringLive.encode: mixed table at " .. pathText(path), 0) end
		visiting[value] = true
		if #keys == 0 then
			if count ~= maxIndex then error("SpringLive.encode: sparse array at " .. pathText(path), 0) end
			table.insert(out, "[")
			for i = 1, maxIndex do
				if i > 1 then table.insert(out, ",") end
				table.insert(path, "[" .. i .. "]")
				encodeValue(value[i], path, visiting, out)
				table.remove(path)
			end
			table.insert(out, "]")
		else
			table.sort(keys)
			table.insert(out, "{")
			for i, k in keys do
				if i > 1 then table.insert(out, ",") end
				table.insert(path, "." .. k)
				table.insert(out, encodeString(k, path))
				table.insert(out, ":")
				encodeValue(value[k], path, visiting, out)
				table.remove(path)
			end
			table.insert(out, "}")
		end
		visiting[value] = nil
	else
		error("SpringLive.encode: unsupported " .. kind .. " at " .. pathText(path), 0)
	end
end

local function encode(value)
	local out = {}
	encodeValue(value, {}, {}, out)
	return table.concat(out)
end

-- Disclosure copy for stats/summaries/receipts: keeps finite numbers exactly, turns non-finite numbers, userdata and
-- unusual keys into strings, so a status report can always be written. Never used for chunk data (those stay strict).
local function sanitize(value, depth, seen)
	depth = depth or 0
	seen = seen or {}
	local kind = type(value)
	if kind == "number" then
		if value ~= value then return "NaN" end
		if value == math.huge then return "Infinity" end
		if value == -math.huge then return "-Infinity" end
		return value
	elseif kind == "string" then
		if utf8.len(value) == nil then return (string.gsub(value, "[\128-\255]", "?")) end
		return value
	elseif kind == "boolean" then
		return value
	elseif kind == "table" then
		if seen[value] then return "<cycle>" end
		if depth > 40 then return "<too deep>" end
		seen[value] = true
		local n, count, hasString = 0, 0, false
		for k in value do
			if type(k) == "number" and k == math.floor(k) and k >= 1 then
				count += 1
				if k > n then n = k end
			else
				hasString = true
			end
		end
		local out = {}
		if not hasString and count == n then
			for i = 1, n do
				local v = sanitize(value[i], depth + 1, seen)
				out[i] = if v == nil then false else v
			end
		else
			for k, v in value do
				local s = sanitize(v, depth + 1, seen)
				if s ~= nil then out[tostring(k)] = s end
			end
		end
		seen[value] = nil
		return out
	elseif kind == "nil" or kind == "function" or kind == "thread" then
		return nil
	end
	local typeName = typeof(value)
	if typeName == "Vector3" then return { x = value.X, y = value.Y, z = value.Z } end
	return "<" .. typeName .. "> " .. tostring(value)
end

local function withoutKey(t, key)
	if type(t) ~= "table" then return t end
	local copy = {}
	for k, v in t do if k ~= key then copy[k] = v end end
	return copy
end

-- Dependencies. Defaults are the Studio services and the sibling ModuleScripts; tests inject doubles.
local function studioSources()
	local out = {}
	for _, name in SOURCE_MODULES do
		local m = script.Parent:FindFirstChild(name)
		if m and m:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			local tag = m:FindFirstChild("SourceSHA256")
			table.insert(out, { name = name, source = m.Source, stamped = m:GetAttribute("sha256") or (tag and tag.Value) })
		else
			table.insert(out, { name = name, missing = true })
		end
	end
	return out
end

local function resolveDeps(injected)
	injected = injected or {}
	assert(type(injected) == "table", "SpringLive: opts.deps must be a table")
	local defaults = {
		Http = function() return game:GetService("HttpService") end,
		CoreGui = function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end,
		RunService = function() return game:GetService("RunService") end,
		workspace = function() return workspace end,
		spawn = function() return task.spawn end,
		wait = function() return task.wait end,
		Instance = function() return Instance end,
		CFrame = function() return CFrame end,
		clock = function() return function() return DateTime.now().UnixTimestampMillis end end,
		warn = function() return warn end,
		moduleSources = function() return studioSources end,
	}
	local deps = {}
	for name, make in defaults do
		local value = injected[name]
		if value == nil then value = make() end
		deps[name] = value
	end
	deps.modules = injected.modules or {}
	deps.expect = injected.expect or EXPECT
	deps.uiEnv = injected.uiEnv
	deps.baseUrl = injected.baseUrl or BASE_URL
	return deps
end

-- The live server's base URL (L9: the port is a start option of the server, so the controller takes it as an option
-- too): opts.baseUrl, else deps.baseUrl (tests), else BASE_URL. Loopback http only, an explicit port 1..65535, no
-- trailing slash, so every request path is baseUrl .. "/spring-live/...".
local function resolveBaseUrl(opts, deps, who)
	local url = if opts.baseUrl ~= nil then opts.baseUrl else deps.baseUrl
	local port = type(url) == "string" and string.match(url, "^http://127%.0%.0%.1:([1-9]%d*)$") or nil
	assert(port ~= nil and tonumber(port) <= 65535,
		who .. ": baseUrl must be http://127.0.0.1:<port> (loopback only, port 1-65535, no trailing slash); got " .. tostring(url))
	return url
end

local function loadModules(deps)
	local m = {}
	for _, name in DEPENDENCIES do
		local value = deps.modules[name]
		if value == nil then
			if script then
				local instance = script.Parent:FindFirstChild(name)
				assert(instance, "SpringLive: module " .. name .. " is not installed next to SpringLive")
				value = require(instance)
			else
				value = require("./" .. name)
			end
		end
		m[name] = value
	end
	return m
end

-- Loopback live server.
-- The network part (yields) and the JSONDecode (CPU) are separate so a prefetch can fetch early and decode between bars.
local function httpText(deps, path, stage)
	local ok, body = pcall(function() return deps.Http:GetAsync(deps.baseUrl .. path) end)
	if not ok then raise(stage or "data", "GET " .. path .. " failed: " .. tostring(body)) end
	return body
end
local function decodeText(deps, path, body, stage)
	local decoded, value = pcall(function() return deps.Http:JSONDecode(body) end)
	if not decoded or type(value) ~= "table" then raise(stage or "data", "GET " .. path .. " returned invalid JSON") end
	return value
end
local function httpGet(deps, path, stage)
	return decodeText(deps, path, httpText(deps, path, stage), stage)
end

-- L4 needs every attempt reported, so a runId that already holds a plan is refused before the pre-flight: a failed
-- attempt is then recorded only in a directory no other run owns. RequestAsync gives the status code without parsing
-- an error message; 404 means the runId is free.
local function checkRunIdFree(deps, runId)
	local path = "/spring-live/chunk?runId=" .. runId .. "&name=plan"
	local ok, response = pcall(function() return deps.Http:RequestAsync({ Url = deps.baseUrl .. path, Method = "GET" }) end)
	if not ok or type(response) ~= "table" then raise("data", "GET " .. path .. " failed: " .. tostring(response)) end
	if response.StatusCode == 404 then return end
	if response.StatusCode == 200 then raise("runid", "runId " .. runId .. " already has a sealed plan; choose a new runId") end
	raise("data", "GET " .. path .. " -> HTTP " .. tostring(response.StatusCode))
end

local function httpPost(deps, runId, name, payload)
	local encodedOk, body = pcall(encode, { runId = runId, name = name, payload = payload })
	if not encodedOk then raise("post", "encoding " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(body)) end
	if #body > MAX_BODY_BYTES then raise("post", name .. " body is " .. #body .. " bytes, over the 48 MB limit") end
	local ok, response = pcall(function()
		return deps.Http:RequestAsync({ Url = deps.baseUrl .. "/spring-live/chunk", Method = "POST",
			Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" }, Body = body })
	end)
	if not ok then raise("post", "POST " .. name .. " failed: " .. tostring(response)) end
	if type(response) ~= "table" or response.Success ~= true or (response.StatusCode ~= 200 and response.StatusCode ~= 201) then
		local code = if type(response) == "table" then tostring(response.StatusCode) else "?"
		local text = if type(response) == "table" then string.sub(tostring(response.Body), 1, 200) else ""
		local f = fault("post", "POST " .. name .. " -> HTTP " .. code .. " " .. text)
		f.httpStatus = if type(response) == "table" then response.StatusCode else nil
		error(f, 0)
	end
	local decoded, receipt = pcall(function() return deps.Http:JSONDecode(response.Body) end)
	if not decoded or type(receipt) ~= "table" or receipt.ok ~= true or not isSha(receipt.sha256) or not isInteger(receipt.bytes) then
		raise("post", "POST " .. name .. " returned an invalid receipt")
	end
	return { name = name, sha256 = receipt.sha256, bytes = receipt.bytes, path = receipt.path, bodyBytes = #body }
end

local function getChunk(deps, runId, name, sha)
	local path = "/spring-live/chunk?runId=" .. runId .. "&name=" .. name .. (if sha then "&sha256=" .. sha else "")
	return httpGet(deps, path, "replay")
end

-- L14 exclusivity. Returns ok, reason. `own` is this controller's BindableFunction (skipped).
local function makeGuard(deps, getOwn)
	return function()
		local CoreGui = deps.CoreGui
		for _, name in BUSY_CONTROLS do
			local control = CoreGui:FindFirstChild(name)
			if control then
				local ok, status = pcall(function() return control:Invoke("status") end)
				if not ok then return false, name .. " status could not be read: " .. tostring(status) end
				if type(status) == "table" and status.busy then return false, name .. " reports busy" end
			end
		end
		if CoreGui:FindFirstChild(SHOWCASE_CONTROL) then return false, SHOWCASE_CONTROL .. " (2024 showcase) is active" end
		local own = getOwn()
		for _, child in CoreGui:GetChildren() do
			if child.Name == CONTROL_NAME and child ~= own then return false, "another " .. CONTROL_NAME .. " is present" end
		end
		return true
	end
end

-- The 2024 showcase leaves a reopen button after a user Exit. One click on it would restart the showcase over the live
-- UI and end the live run through the guard, so the live controller removes it (SpringShowcase's own programmatic
-- takeover does the same). Returns how many were removed.
local function removeLaunchers(CoreGui)
	local removed = 0
	for _, child in CoreGui:GetChildren() do
		if child.Name == SHOWCASE_LAUNCHER then
			if pcall(function() child:Destroy() end) then removed += 1 end
		end
	end
	return removed
end

-- Step 1: exit the 2024 showcase and idle old live controls; refuse while an old live run is still stepping.
local function exitOthers(deps)
	local CoreGui = deps.CoreGui
	local showcase = CoreGui:FindFirstChild(SHOWCASE_CONTROL)
	if showcase then
		pcall(function() showcase:Invoke("exit") end)
		assert(showcase.Parent == nil and CoreGui:FindFirstChild(SHOWCASE_CONTROL) == nil,
			"SpringLive: " .. SHOWCASE_CONTROL .. " did not exit; close the 2024 showcase first")
	end
	local launchers = removeLaunchers(CoreGui)
	assert(CoreGui:FindFirstChild(SHOWCASE_LAUNCHER) == nil, "SpringLive: the 2024 showcase reopen button could not be removed")
	for _, child in CoreGui:GetChildren() do
		if child.Name == CONTROL_NAME then
			local ok, status = pcall(function() return child:Invoke("status") end)
			assert(ok and type(status) == "table", "SpringLive: an old " .. CONTROL_NAME .. " does not answer status; remove it first")
			assert(not status.running and not status.busy, string.format("SpringLive: live run %s is still stepping (bar %s); invoke stop on %s first",
				tostring(status.runId), tostring(status.decided), CONTROL_NAME))
			assert(not status.captureRetained, "SpringLive: the previous capture is retained for inspection; invoke release on " .. CONTROL_NAME .. " first")
			pcall(function() child:Invoke("exit") end)
			if child.Parent ~= nil then child:Destroy() end
		end
	end
	return launchers
end

-- Viewer: the UI, the shared cursor (follow / play / scrub) and the control. Shared by start() and replay().
local function newViewer(deps, modules, options)
	local Frozen = modules.SpringFrozenV1
	local V = {
		state = { viewRun = options.viewRun or "coupled", compareRun = options.compareRun or "zero", index = 0,
			following = true, playing = false, rate = math.clamp(tonumber(options.rate) or 6, 0.5, 60) },
		ui = { mounted = false, errors = 0, lastError = nil },
		labels = {},
		decided = 0,
		session = nil,
		framed = false,
		cameraWrites = 0,
	}
	local state, ui = V.state, V.ui

	local function uiError(where, err)
		ui.errors += 1
		ui.lastError = where .. ": " .. tostring(err)
	end
	local function guarded(where, fn, ...)
		local ok, err = pcall(fn, ...)
		if not ok then uiError(where, err) end
		return ok
	end

	function V.render()
		local session, i = V.session, state.index
		if not ui.mounted or not session or i < 1 or i > V.decided then return false end
		local rowOk, row = pcall(function() return session:displayRow(state.viewRun, i) end)
		if not rowOk then uiError("displayRow", row); return false end
		local compareOk, compareRow = pcall(function() return session:displayRow(state.compareRun, i) end)
		if not compareOk then uiError("displayRow compare", compareRow); compareRow = nil end
		if ui.view then guarded("view", function() ui.view:update(row) end) end
		if ui.panel then
			guarded("panel", function() ui.panel:update(row, compareRow, session:context(state.viewRun, state.compareRun)) end)
		end
		if ui.chart then
			guarded("chart", function()
				ui.chart:update(i, session:bars(), session:rows(state.viewRun),
					{ runLabel = SHORT_LABELS[state.viewRun] or state.viewRun, label = V.labels[i], labels = V.labels })
			end)
		end
		return true
	end

	-- The last status text is kept so a UI brought back with "show" starts with it.
	function V.setStatusLine(text)
		V.statusText = text
		if ui.mounted and ui.panel then guarded("status", function() ui.panel:setStatus(text) end) end
	end

	local function syncPlaying()
		if ui.mounted and ui.panel then guarded("panel playing", function() ui.panel:setPlaying(state.playing) end) end
	end

	-- Moves the cursor over decided rows only; any explicit move leaves follow mode (L11).
	function V.seek(index)
		if V.decided < 1 then return 0 end
		state.following = false
		state.index = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(index) or state.index), 1, V.decided)
		V.render()
		return state.index
	end
	function V.setPlaying(playing)
		state.playing = playing == true
		state.following = false
		if state.index < 1 then state.index = math.min(1, V.decided) end
		syncPlaying()
		return state.playing
	end
	function V.follow()
		state.following, state.playing = true, false
		syncPlaying()
		state.index = V.decided
		V.render()
		return true
	end
	-- Called by the capture loop after every decided row.
	function V.onDecided(index, label)
		V.decided = index
		V.labels[index] = label
		if state.following then
			state.index = index
			V.render()
		end
	end
	local function knownRun(id)
		local session = V.session
		if type(id) ~= "string" or not session then return false end
		local ok, runs = pcall(function() return session:runs() end)
		if not ok or type(runs) ~= "table" then return false end
		for _, run in runs do if run.id == id then return true end end
		return false
	end
	function V.selectRun(id)
		if not knownRun(id) then return false end
		state.viewRun = id
		V.render()
		return true
	end
	function V.selectCompare(id)
		if not knownRun(id) then return false end
		state.compareRun = id
		V.render()
		return true
	end
	function V.find(runId, action, from)
		local session = V.session
		if not session or V.decided < 1 then return nil end
		local rows = session:rows(runId or state.viewRun)
		if type(rows) ~= "table" then return nil end
		for i = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(from) or 1)), V.decided do
			local r = rows[i]
			if r and r.fa == action then return i end
		end
		return nil
	end

	-- The camera is framed once, from the replay model's view attributes, and never written again (D25, L11).
	local function frameOnce()
		if V.framed or options.frame == false then return end
		V.framed = true
		local model = (ui.view and ui.view.model) or deps.workspace:FindFirstChild(REPLAY_MODEL)
		if not model then return end
		local focus, at = model:GetAttribute("FocusPosition"), model:GetAttribute("ViewPosition")
		if focus == nil or at == nil then return end
		local camera = deps.workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then return end
		camera.CFrame = deps.CFrame.lookAt(at, focus)
		camera.Focus = deps.CFrame.new(focus)
		local fov = model:GetAttribute("ViewFieldOfView")
		if type(fov) == "number" then camera.FieldOfView = fov end
		V.cameraWrites += 1
	end

	function V.mount(session)
		V.session = session
		local descriptor = Frozen.descriptor
		local env = deps.uiEnv
		guarded("view mount", function() ui.view = modules.SpringReplayView.mount(deps.workspace, descriptor, { env = env }) end)
		guarded("panel mount", function()
			ui.panel = modules.SpringPanel.mount(deps.CoreGui, {
				descriptor = descriptor,
				env = env,
				callbacks = {
					onRun = function(id) V.selectRun(id) end,
					onPlay = function() V.setPlaying(true) end,
					onPause = function() V.setPlaying(false) end,
					onStep = function(delta) V.setPlaying(false); V.seek(state.index + (tonumber(delta) or 1)) end,
					onScrub = function(index) V.seek(index) end,
					onExit = function() V.exitUI() end,
				},
			})
			local runs = session:runs()
			local shown = {}
			for k, run in runs do
				local copy = table.clone(run)
				copy.label = SHORT_LABELS[run.id] or run.label
				shown[k] = copy
			end
			ui.panel:setRuns(shown)
		end)
		guarded("chart mount", function()
			local inset = if type(modules.SpringPanel.WIDTH) == "number" then modules.SpringPanel.WIDTH + 12 else 452
			ui.chart = modules.SpringChart.mount(deps.CoreGui, { rightInset = inset, env = env })
		end)
		ui.mounted = true
		guarded("camera", frameOnce)
		local accumulated = 0
		local okBeat, connection = pcall(function()
			return deps.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
				if not state.playing or not ui.mounted then accumulated = 0; return end
				accumulated += (tonumber(dt) or 0) * state.rate
				if accumulated < 1 then return end
				local steps = math.floor(accumulated)
				accumulated -= steps
				if state.index + steps >= V.decided then
					-- Reaching the newest decided row switches back to following the capture (L11).
					V.follow()
				else
					state.index += steps
					V.render()
				end
			end)
		end)
		if okBeat then ui.heartbeat = connection else uiError("heartbeat", connection) end
		if V.statusText then V.setStatusLine(V.statusText) end
	end

	-- Brings the UI back after Exit (the run never stopped). The camera was framed once and is never framed again. While
	-- hidden, onDecided kept the cursor on the newest row when following, so the view comes back where it should be.
	function V.show()
		if ui.mounted then return true end
		if not V.session then return false end
		V.mount(V.session)
		syncPlaying()
		V.render()
		return true
	end

	-- Closes the UI only (L11): the capture loop, if any, keeps running; status and stop keep working.
	function V.exitUI()
		if not ui.mounted then return true end
		ui.mounted = false
		state.playing = false
		if ui.heartbeat then pcall(function() ui.heartbeat:Disconnect() end) end
		for _, key in { "panel", "chart", "view" } do
			local item = ui[key]
			ui[key] = nil
			if item then pcall(function() item:destroy() end) end
		end
		if options.onExitUI then options.onExitUI() end
		return true
	end

	return V
end

local function reproducibilityOf(session)
	if not session then return nil end
	local ok, value = pcall(function() return session:reproducibility() end)
	if not ok then return { status = "error", error = tostring(value) } end
	return sanitize(value)
end

local function makeControl(deps, viewer, handlers)
	local control = deps.Instance.new("BindableFunction")
	control.Name = CONTROL_NAME
	control.OnInvoke = function(command, ...)
		local args = { ... }
		if command == "status" then return handlers.status() end
		-- On demand (never per bar): the session's L3b/L20 lead-in comparison so far, so the lead can check exact drives
		-- and states after a few bars instead of waiting for row captureRows. nil before the session exists.
		if command == "reproducibility" then return handlers.reproducibility() end
		if command == "stop" then return handlers.stop() end
		if command == "release" then return if handlers.release then handlers.release() else false end
		if command == "exit" then return handlers.exit() end
		if command == "show" then return viewer.show() end
		if not viewer.ui.mounted then
			if command == "run" or command == "compare" or command == "seek" or command == "play" or command == "pause"
				or command == "follow" or command == "rate" or command == "find" then
				return false
			end
		end
		if command == "run" then return viewer.selectRun(args[1])
		elseif command == "compare" then return viewer.selectCompare(args[1])
		elseif command == "seek" then return viewer.seek(args[1])
		elseif command == "play" then return viewer.setPlaying(true)
		elseif command == "pause" then viewer.setPlaying(false); return true
		elseif command == "follow" then return viewer.follow()
		elseif command == "rate" then
			viewer.state.rate = math.clamp(tonumber(args[1]) or 6, 0.5, 60)
			return viewer.state.rate
		elseif command == "find" then return viewer.find(args[1], args[2], args[3])
		end
		error(CONTROL_NAME .. ": unknown command " .. tostring(command))
	end
	control.Parent = deps.CoreGui
	return control
end
